text.tspan: Signals by peripheral function. Package balls/pins: assign from the MPC5744P IO signal table; record in config/board_cfg.h.
• Pull-down 10 kΩ on every PWM, GATE_EN and DO_* line: outputs are off while the MCU is in reset or unpowered.
• nFAULT: 4.7 kΩ pull-up to 3V3, wired-OR of the six gate driver FLT outputs; also routed to a GPIO for diagnosis.
• Decoupling: 100 nF per supply pin + bulk per data sheet; VREFH filtered from 3V3_A.
